payload.headline: NEW - A new study shows crickets actively groom and "nurse" injured antennae with flexible, targeted behaviour that goes beyond simple reflexes, strengthening the case that some insects may feel pain,
payload.body: NEW - A new study shows crickets actively groom and "nurse" injured antennae with flexible, targeted behaviour that goes beyond simple reflexes, strengthening the case that some insects may feel pain, highlighting potential welfare concerns for commercial cricket farming. Source: https://royalsocietypublishing.org/rspb/article-abstract/293/2070/20260609/481623/Flexible-self-protection-as-evidence-of-pain-like?redirectedFrom=fulltext @disclosetv
